title: nai
summary: A set of Jupyter notebooks generating synthetic fMRI-derived tabular data to augment autism spectrum disorder classification datasets using GAN-based synthesis. The notebooks train a standalone CTGANSynthesizer to produce synthetic samples and then call SDV's evaluate() function with CSTest/KSTest metrics to validate the synthetic data quality.
